description: ADO-CURSOR source and Options crossing: server keyset read-only Recordset.Open of the sources T, QAll, QByL (parameter unset), 'SELECT ID FROM T', 'EXEC QAll', '{call QAll}' and 'NoSuchThing' with Options adCmdUnknown, adCmdText, adCmdTable, adCmdStoredProc and adCmdTableDirect as listed (fifteen combinations); each reads State, Fields.Count, the Source property, RecordCount and the Errors (cleared). Then a Command (QAll as stored procedure) is passed as Source with and without the ActiveConnection argument (State, Source, ActiveConnection). Asks which source forms each Options value accepts and what Source reads back.
